notes: Reads the live token from this host's own `gh auth login` session. Run `gh auth login` once on this host if it isn't already.

command:
set -euo pipefail
creds_file="$HOME/.claude/.credentials.json"
refresh_token=$(jq -r '.claudeAiOauth.refreshToken // empty' "$creds_file")
if [ -z "$refresh_token" ]; then
  echo "$creds_file: claudeAiOauth.refreshToken missing -- run \`claude\` and log in on this host first" >&2
  exit 1
fi
body=$(jq -n --arg rt "$refresh_token" '{client_id:"9d1c250a-e61b-44d9-88ed-5944d1962f5e",grant_type:"refresh_token",refresh_token:$rt,scope:"user:profile user:inference user:sessions:claude_code user:mcp_servers user:file_upload"}')
resp=$(curl -fsS -X POST https://platform.claude.com/v1/oauth/token \
  -H 'Accept: application/json, text/plain, */*' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'User-Agent: axios/1.15.2' \
  -H 'Connection: close' \
  -d "$body")
access_token=$(echo "$resp" | jq -r '.access_token // empty')
if [ -z "$access_token" ]; then
  echo "refresh response missing access_token" >&2
  exit 1
fi
new_refresh=$(echo "$resp" | jq -r '.refresh_token // empty')
if [ -z "$new_refresh" ]; then
  new_refresh="$refresh_token"
fi
mode=$(stat -c %a "$creds_file")
tmp="$creds_file.tmp"
jq --arg at "$access_token" --arg rt "$new_refresh" '.claudeAiOauth.refreshToken=$rt | .claudeAiOauth.accessToken=$at' "$creds_file" > "$tmp"
chmod "$mode" "$tmp"
mv "$tmp" "$creds_file"
echo "$access_token"
notes: Refreshes whichever account is logged into Claude Code on this host (~/.claude/.credentials.json). Run `claude` and log in once on this host first.

command:
set -euo pipefail
auth_file="$HOME/.codex/auth.json"
refresh_token=$(jq -r '.tokens.refresh_token // empty' "$auth_file")
if [ -z "$refresh_token" ]; then
  echo "$auth_file: tokens.refresh_token missing -- run \`codex login\` on this host first" >&2
  exit 1
fi
resp=$(curl -fsS -X POST https://auth.openai.com/oauth/token \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  --data-urlencode client_id=app_EMoamEEZ73f0CkXaXp7hrann \
  --data-urlencode grant_type=refresh_token \
  --data-urlencode refresh_token="$refresh_token" \
  --data-urlencode 'scope=openid profile email')
access_token=$(echo "$resp" | jq -r '.access_token // empty')
new_refresh=$(echo "$resp" | jq -r '.refresh_token // empty')
if [ -z "$access_token" ] || [ -z "$new_refresh" ]; then
  echo "refresh response missing access_token or refresh_token" >&2
  exit 1
fi
mode=$(stat -c %a "$auth_file")
tmp="$auth_file.tmp"
jq --arg at "$access_token" --arg rt "$new_refresh" '.tokens.access_token=$at | .tokens.refresh_token=$rt' "$auth_file" > "$tmp"
chmod "$mode" "$tmp"
mv "$tmp" "$auth_file"
echo "$access_token"
notes: Refreshes whichever account is logged into Codex on this host (~/.codex/auth.json). Run `codex login` once on this host first.
